How Thomas Jefferson connects

  • Character: Daveed Diggs — Daveed Diggs originated Jefferson in the second act.
  • Work: Cabinet Battle — Jefferson faces Hamilton across the Cabinet Battle desks.

What is Thomas Jefferson?

Thomas Jefferson returns from France as the show's second-act foil, a Democratic-Republican in purple who faces Hamilton across Washington's Cabinet Battle desks.

Key threads lead to Daveed Diggs, Cabinet Battle and James Madison.
